orena_rl.note: Comparable to Fireworks ORena RL: same base model, 2000 rows, 8 samples/prompt, 512-token cap, temp 0.7, kl 0.04. exact_match 0.146 -> 0.375 (vs Fireworks 0.191 -> 0.282). Per-step exact_match is over 64 prompts (vs Fireworks 200-row chunks), so noisy; see orena_rl_final_results.json + analysis/plots/orena_rl_miles_vs_fireworks.png.

goemotions_sft.note: Not run on Miles. This leg covers RL only.

goemotions_rl.note: First run invalidated by Qwen3 default enable_thinking=True (model rambled to the 64-token cap, reward ~0). Rerun with enable_thinking=False fixed it; see final_results.json.

findings: Base model for text RL matches Fireworks exactly: Qwen3-0.6B. Same dataset, same 64-token cap, same Jaccard reward — apples-to-apples.

Qwen3's chat template defaults to enable_thinking=True, which made the model fill the whole 64-token budget with <think> reasoning and score zero. Fix = --apply-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}' (Fireworks runs this model with enable_thinking=False).

Miles (self-hosted GRPO, KL=0) reaches final Jaccard 0.60 vs Fireworks 0.34, and sampled micro-F1 ~0.44 vs 0.38 — but ends at 100% truncated responses, so the higher Jaccard is partly verbose-but-parseable output.
FSDP saves DCP (torch.distributed.checkpoint); export_hf is Megatron-only, so a held-out eval needs a DCP->HF loader.

ORena VLM RL (Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, 2000 rows, 1 epoch) on a p4d.24xlarge spot node: exact_match 0.146 -> 0.375 (peak 0.420), correctness 0.179 -> 0.441. Fireworks on the same setup: 0.191 -> 0.282. Miles starts lower but finishes higher; both are training-signal curves, and Miles' per-step points are over 64 prompts (vs Fireworks' 200-row chunks) so the Miles curve is noisier (it dips to ~0.01-0.08 around steps 4-14 before recovering).

Three A100-specific gotchas cost ~2.5 hrs of spot time before the run trained: (1) the image bundles flash-attn-4, which transformer_engine selects OVER FA2 on sm80 and which crashes on Qwen3-VL-8B's 32Q/8KV GQA layout — fix = pip uninstall flash-attn-4; (2) --num-rollout counts rollout STEPS not rollouts (--num-rollout 2000 = 64 epochs), fix = --num-epoch 1; (3) exact_match (the reported metric) is not logged by default — only correctness is — fix = a --custom-rollout-log-function-path hook.
